_law: A site listed here forwards caller headers to a URL taken from a provider response. That is only acceptable when the request re-decides, PER PHYSICAL SEND, whether the current hop is the API origin — because redirects, caller plugins and string-keyed interceptors all run after a one-time check. Naming credential headers to strip is not a fix; that denylist shape leaked twice. Removing a site from this file is the preferred change; adding one needs the reason stated.

reviewedCredentialForwardingSites.src/commonMain/kotlin/ai/torad/aisdk/pro: Same-origin hops keep the full provider + per-call header baseline because a signed Fireworks download can legitimately require them (FireworksPollingStatusTest asserts a custom x-api-key reaches the same-origin asset). Safe because headersForImageDownload is re-evaluated on EVERY physical send via a policy subscribed on the built client at HttpRequestIsReadyForSending, and off-origin hops clear the header set entirely rather than filtering names.
